Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert ## agent_task_preamble.md You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ## review_coding_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` ## general_guidelines.md # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ### External-spec evidence rule A finding whose core claim is "**the spec / reference / ticket / external tool says or does X**" may be raised at 🚨 **BLOCKING** only when it quotes the exact source the review actually read during this run — a `file:line` reference or a doc URL. A bare "the spec says …" assertion is unfalsifiable for the author and for the machine, and a false one holds a validated PR hostage (live: a BLOCKING thread claiming an exemption list that the reference source did not contain — the reviewed code was behaviorally identical to it). Without a verifiable citation: - Downgrade the finding to ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**, phrased as a question: "Please confirm against `` — if confirmed, this becomes blocking." - Never let an uncited spec assertion be the sole reason for `REQUEST_CHANGES`. This is not a strictness cut: a spec-claim finding **with** a verifiable citation keeps full 🚨 BLOCKING force. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` …

## PR Description

Closes #1738.

## What

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).
- Bit-identical cross-package test copies **deleted**: `flutter_app/test/media_models_store_test.dart` and `flutter_app/test/session_keys_store_test.dart`. Both stores live in `packages/fa_ui` (`flutter_app/lib/services/*.dart` are one-line re-export shims); the flutter_app test copies differed from the fa_ui copies *only in the import lines* (fa_ui barrel vs shim paths). fa_ui keeps testing both stores beside the implementation — the card's preferred resolution ("whichever keeps both packages testing the store"). Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). They are codegen'd via `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` into separate Dart consts consumed with exact-string equality in 13 test assertions across 3 flutter-only test files; parameterizing means regenerating consts and rewriting exact-string tests in a package this lane cannot run — that's the prompt-corpus refactor card, not this one. Reason recorded in `crap4dart.yaml`.
- `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

## AC table

| AC | Status | Proof |
|----|--------|-------|
| AC1 — config + `check --only similarity` exits 0 | **MET** | `similarity: enabled: true`, md+dart, jaccard 0.5, containment 0.85 in `crap4dart.yaml`. `check --only similarity --baseline` → `exit 0` (`[PASS] similarity: 25 files in 12 similar-file clusters (3498 scanned)`). Note: plain `check --only similarity` (no `--baseline`) reports the 25 baselined findings and exits 2 — CI's quality-gates step runs `check --baseline`, which is the card's "only *new* near-duplicates fail" mode (AC1's exit-0 and AC4's mandatory baselining can only coexist in that mode). |
| AC2 — generated pairs glob-excluded with rationale | **MET** | `firebase_options.template.dart` + both `firebase_options.dart` copies + `app_localizations_*.dart` excluded via glob with comments (FlutterFire CLI output / gen-l10n ARB output). Also excluded with comments: `vendor/**` (every other gate excludes it; the card's 1637-file count implies vendor was out of its scope), `site/**` (generated deploy output of blog/), `.fah/**` (installed runtime mirrors of prompts/skills), `flutter_app/test/fixtures/retired_*.md` (frozen retired-revision fixture). |
| AC3 — bit-identical pair resolved; 0 clusters outside excludes+baseline | **MET** | Both 1.00 pairs (media_models_store, session_keys_store) deleted (see above). Post-change scan: 12 clusters / 25 files — all historical, all baselined. |
| AC4 — baseline captured; new duplicate fails | **MET** | `check --save-baseline` recorded 25 similarity findings (12 clusters). Negative proof, in the exact CI mode: copied `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` to a scratch doc → `check --only similarity --baseline` → `[FAIL] ... 27 files in 13 clusters` **exit 2** → scratch removed → gate green again. Baseline keys include the jaccard/containment values, so any drift in a clustered file re-fails the gate (deliberate re-baseline required). |
| AC5 — CI pins `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` | **MET** | Both `pub global activate crap4dart` lines in ci.yml bumped with gh-1738 comments. |

## Tooling disclosure

Ran locally in the worktree with the standalone Dart SDK recipe (`pub global activate crap4dart` → **0.15.0**, exact version as CI's new pin):

```
similarity scan (config)              3498 scanned, 281 skipped -> 25 files / 12 clusters
check --only similarity --baseline    exit 0
check --baseline (all gates)          exit 0  (loc PASS, broken_goldens PASS, duplication WARN-by-design)
check --only similarity               exit 2  (plain mode; reports the baselined inventory — disclosure line)
scratch-duplicate negative probe      exit 2  -> reverted -> green
```

## Fresh json re-inventory (card REG: exclude list changes require it)

3498 scanned (vendor/site/.fah excluded) → 12 clusters / 25 files, every cluster baselined with a reason in `crap4dart.yaml`:

1. `test/ci_{core_shard,pty_artifact,shard_evidence}_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (0.81/0.81/0.58) — sibling retry-guard scaffolding
2. `flutter_app/integration_test/{bash,edit}_tool_test.dart` (0.66) — card-named scaffolding
3. `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_preflight_probe_io.dart` ⇄ `flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart` (0.75) — probe + its guard
4. `ws_connector_io` ⇄ `ws_connector_web` (0.56) — platform-split twins
5. `folder_picker_web` ⇄ `upload_picker_web` (0.61) — picker family
6. `transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md` (0.55) — card twins, baseline-with-comment
7. `media_slot_picker_page_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.59) — drifted cross-package siblings
8. `provider_registry_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.62, containment 1.00) — fa_ui copy is a superset
9. `{transformers_js,webllm}_cache_section_test` (0.53) — provider twins
10. `agent_cli_tui_{adapter,socket}403_test` (0.52) — two flavours of one regression test
11. `fa_cli_thinking_{abort,livestream_pty}_test` — thinking-stream scaffolding
12. `provider_{ollama,openrouter}_test` — card-named scaffolding (anthropic leg drifted below threshold since the card's measurement)

Resolved vs the card's measurement: media_models_store + session_keys_store 1.00 pairs deleted; firebase + l10n pairs excluded. The tree drifted since the card's scan (upload_retry triple, cache_section, 403 and thinking pairs appeared) — all captured in the baseline with reasons.

## Disclosures

The stale 0.14.2 baseline no longer matches under 0.15.0 — CI's `check --baseline` would be red on the version bump alone. # crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  # TEMP raise (crap4dart 0.11.0 -> 0.14.2 migration, PR #1637, re-opens the
  # gh-1234 repin under the new analyzer): 0.14.2 counts pattern-matching /
  # switch complexity higher, re-measuring the provider-queue cluster above
  # the old 12.0 line. Measured on the CI pipeline (core coverage shards of
  # run 39324246012, merged via scripts/merge_lcov.py, analyze lib bin):
  # max CRAP 90.00 (`_typeName`, providers_queue.dart:629, CC 9 @ 0% cov),
  # then 35.00 (`BindingProvenance.label`, provider_model_binding.dart:69,
  # CC 8 @ 25%). Restore to 12.0 by decomposing the cluster under 0.14.2.
  # raise-issue: gh-1713
  threshold: 90.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). ERROR since crap4dart >=0.14.2 fixed the upstream
  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: terminal text is blocky mono
      # glyphs that read as solid Ahem rectangles (5 theme screenshots,
      # crap4dart 0.14.2), and omp_ref/03_tool_call.png genuinely
      # contains a yellow/black pattern. Not golden images — excluded,
      # not a detector bug to chase.
      - 'test/integration/**'

  # File-level near-duplicate gate (issue #1738, crap4dart 0.15.0).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
pre-commit

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert ## agent_task_preamble.md You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ## review_coding_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` ## general_guidelines.md # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,
ci_failures_full.log, pr_discussions.md,
pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ### External-spec evidence rule A finding whose core claim is "**the spec / reference / ticket / external tool says or does X**" may be raised at 🚨 **BLOCKING** only when it quotes the exact source the review actually read during this run — a `file:line` reference or a doc URL. A bare "the spec says …" assertion is unfalsifiable for the author and for the machine, and a false one holds a validated PR hostage (live: a BLOCKING thread claiming an exemption list that the reference source did not contain — the reviewed code was behaviorally identical to it). Without a verifiable citation: - Downgrade the finding to ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**, phrased as a question: "Please confirm against `` — if confirmed, this becomes blocking." - Never let an uncited spec assertion be the sole reason for `REQUEST_CHANGES`. ## PR Description

Closes #1738.

## What

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).
- Bit-identical cross-package test copies **deleted**: `flutter_app/test/media_models_store_test.dart` and `flutter_app/test/session_keys_store_test.dart`. Both stores live in `packages/fa_ui` (`flutter_app/lib/services/*.dart` are one-line re-export shims); the flutter_app test copies differed from the fa_ui copies *only in the import lines* (fa_ui barrel vs shim paths). fa_ui keeps testing both stores beside the implementation — the card's preferred resolution ("whichever keeps both packages testing the store"). Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). They are codegen'd via `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` into separate Dart consts consumed with exact-string equality in 13 test assertions across 3 flutter-only test files; parameterizing means regenerating consts and rewriting exact-string tests in a package this lane cannot run — that's the prompt-corpus refactor card, not this one. Reason recorded in `crap4dart.yaml`.
- `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

## AC table

| AC | Status | Proof |
|----|--------|-------|
| AC1 — config + `check --only similarity` exits 0 | **MET** | `similarity: enabled: true`, md+dart, jaccard 0.5, containment 0.85 in `crap4dart.yaml`. `check --only similarity --baseline` → `exit 0` (`[PASS] similarity: 25 files in 12 similar-file clusters (3498 scanned)`). Note: plain `check --only similarity` (no `--baseline`) reports the 25 baselined findings and exits 2 — CI's quality-gates step runs `check --baseline`, which is the card's "only *new* near-duplicates fail" mode (AC1's exit-0 and AC4's mandatory baselining can only coexist in that mode). |
| AC2 — generated pairs glob-excluded with rationale | **MET** | `firebase_options.template.dart` + both `firebase_options.dart` copies + `app_localizations_*.dart` excluded via glob with comments (FlutterFire CLI output / gen-l10n ARB output). Also excluded with comments: `vendor/**` (every other gate excludes it; the card's 1637-file count implies vendor was out of its scope), `site/**` (generated deploy output of blog/), `.fah/**` (installed runtime mirrors of prompts/skills), `flutter_app/test/fixtures/retired_*.md` (frozen retired-revision fixture). |
| AC3 — bit-identical pair resolved; 0 clusters outside excludes+baseline | **MET** | Both 1.00 pairs (media_models_store, session_keys_store) deleted (see above). Post-change scan: 12 clusters / 25 files — all historical, all baselined. |
| AC4 — baseline captured; new duplicate fails | **MET** | `check --save-baseline` recorded 25 similarity findings (12 clusters). Negative proof, in the exact CI mode: copied `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` to a scratch doc → `check --only similarity --baseline` → `[FAIL] ... 27 files in 13 clusters` **exit 2** → scratch removed → gate green again. Baseline keys include the jaccard/containment values, so any drift in a clustered file re-fails the gate (deliberate re-baseline required). |
| AC5 — CI pins `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` | **MET** | Both `pub global activate crap4dart` lines in ci.yml bumped with gh-1738 comments. |

check --baseline (all gates)          exit 0  (loc PASS, broken_goldens PASS, duplication WARN-by-design)
check --only similarity               exit 2  (plain mode; reports the baselined inventory — disclosure line)
scratch-duplicate negative probe      exit 2  -> reverted -> green
```

3498 scanned (vendor/site/.fah excluded) → 12 clusters / 25 files, every cluster baselined with a reason in `crap4dart.yaml`:

1. `test/ci_{core_shard,pty_artifact,shard_evidence}_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (0.81/0.81/0.58) — sibling retry-guard scaffolding
2. `flutter_app/integration_test/{bash,edit}_tool_test.dart` (0.66) — card-named scaffolding
3. `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_preflight_probe_io.dart` ⇄ `flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart` (0.75) — probe + its guard
4. `ws_connector_io` ⇄ `ws_connector_web` (0.56) — platform-split twins
5. `folder_picker_web` ⇄ `upload_picker_web` (0.61) — picker family
6. `transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md` (0.55) — card twins, baseline-with-comment
7. `media_slot_picker_page_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.59) — drifted cross-package siblings
8. `provider_registry_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.62, containment 1.00) — fa_ui copy is a superset
9. `{transformers_js,webllm}_cache_section_test` (0.53) — provider twins
10. `agent_cli_tui_{adapter,socket}403_test` (0.52) — two flavours of one regression test
11. `fa_cli_thinking_{abort,livestream_pty}_test` — thinking-stream scaffolding
12. `provider_{ollama,openrouter}_test` — card-named scaffolding (anthropic leg drifted below threshold since the card's measurement)

Resolved vs the card's measurement: media_models_store + session_keys_store 1.00 pairs deleted; firebase + l10n pairs excluded. The tree drifted since the card's scan (upload_retry triple, cache_section, 403 and thinking pairs appeared) — all captured in the baseline with reasons.

## Disclosures

- **Duplication baseline re-recorded under 0.15.0**: the AC5 pin bump re-measures the `duplication` gate (216 → 245 entries; the detector's output changed with the version). The stale 0.14.2 baseline no longer matches under 0.15.0 — CI's `check --baseline` would be red on the version bump alone. Duplication stays severity `warning` (soft window per config), similarity is `error`.
- **CI is the arbiter** for the two flutter_app test deletions (flutter suite not runnable on this box) and for the exact 0.15.0-vs-0.15.x resolver behavior.

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  # TEMP raise (crap4dart 0.11.0 -> 0.14.2 migration, PR #1637, re-opens the
  # gh-1234 repin under the new analyzer): 0.14.2 counts pattern-matching /
  # switch complexity higher, re-measuring the provider-queue cluster above
  # the old 12.0 line. Measured on the CI pipeline (core coverage shards of
  # run 39324246012, merged via scripts/merge_lcov.py, analyze lib bin):
  # max CRAP 90.00 (`_typeName`, providers_queue.dart:629, CC 9 @ 0% cov),
  # then 35.00 (`BindingProvenance.label`, provider_model_binding.dart:69,
  # CC 8 @ 25%). Restore to 12.0 by decomposing the cluster under 0.14.2.
  # raise-issue: gh-1713
  threshold: 90.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
pre-commit

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1774
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1774
- **Title**: feat(1738): similarity gate — 0 untracked near-duplicates in CI
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1738-similarity-gate` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +731
- **Deletions**: -817
- **Created**: 2026-10-21T21:21:13Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-22T01:57:32Z

## PR Description

Closes #1738.

## What

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).
- Bit-identical cross-package test copies **deleted**: `flutter_app/test/media_models_store_test.dart` and `flutter_app/test/session_keys_store_test.dart`. Both stores live in `packages/fa_ui` (`flutter_app/lib/services/*.dart` are one-line re-export shims); the flutter_app test copies differed from the fa_ui copies *only in the import lines* (fa_ui barrel vs shim paths). fa_ui keeps testing both stores beside the implementation — the card's preferred resolution ("whichever keeps both packages testing the store"). Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). They are codegen'd via `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` into separate Dart consts consumed with exact-string equality in 13 test assertions across 3 flutter-only test files; parameterizing means regenerating consts and rewriting exact-string tests in a package this lane cannot run — that's the prompt-corpus refactor card, not this one. Reason recorded in `crap4dart.yaml`.
- `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

## AC table

| AC | Status | Proof |
|----|--------|-------|
| AC1 — config + `check --only similarity` exits 0 | **MET** | `similarity: enabled: true`, md+dart, jaccard 0.5, containment 0.85 in `crap4dart.yaml`. `check --only similarity --baseline` → `exit 0` (`[PASS] similarity: 25 files in 12 similar-file clusters (3498 scanned)`). Note: plain `check --only similarity` (no `--baseline`) reports the 25 baselined findings and exits 2 — CI's quality-gates step runs `check --baseline`, which is the card's "only *new* near-duplicates fail" mode (AC1's exit-0 and AC4's mandatory baselining can only coexist in that mode). |
| AC2 — generated pairs glob-excluded with rationale | **MET** | `firebase_options.template.dart` + both `firebase_options.dart` copies + `app_localizations_*.dart` excluded via glob with comments (FlutterFire CLI output / gen-l10n ARB output). Also excluded with comments: `vendor/**` (every other gate excludes it; the card's 1637-file count implies vendor was out of its scope), `site/**` (generated deploy output of blog/), `.fah/**` (installed runtime mirrors of prompts/skills), `flutter_app/test/fixtures/retired_*.md` (frozen retired-revision fixture). |
| AC3 — bit-identical pair resolved; 0 clusters outside excludes+baseline | **MET** | Both 1.00 pairs (media_models_store, session_keys_store) deleted (see above). Post-change scan: 12 clusters / 25 files — all historical, all baselined. |
| AC4 — baseline captured; new duplicate fails | **MET** | `check --save-baseline` recorded 25 similarity findings (12 clusters). Negative proof, in the exact CI mode: copied `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` to a scratch doc → `check --only similarity --baseline` → `[FAIL] ... 27 files in 13 clusters` **exit 2** → scratch removed → gate green again. Baseline keys include the jaccard/containment values, so any drift in a clustered file re-fails the gate (deliberate re-baseline required). |
| AC5 — CI pins `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` | **MET** | Both `pub global activate crap4dart` lines in ci.yml bumped with gh-1738 comments. |

## Tooling disclosure

Ran locally in the worktree with the standalone Dart SDK recipe (`pub global activate crap4dart` → **0.15.0**, exact version as CI's new pin):

```
similarity scan (config)              3498 scanned, 281 skipped -> 25 files / 12 clusters
check --only similarity --baseline    exit 0
check --baseline (all gates)          exit 0  (loc PASS, broken_goldens PASS, duplication WARN-by-design)
check --only similarity               exit 2  (plain mode; reports the baselined inventory — disclosure line)
scratch-duplicate negative probe      exit 2  -> reverted -> green
```

## Fresh json re-inventory (card REG: exclude list changes require it)

3498 scanned (vendor/site/.fah excluded) → 12 clusters / 25 files, every cluster baselined with a reason in `crap4dart.yaml`:

1. `test/ci_{core_shard,pty_artifact,shard_evidence}_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (0.81/0.81/0.58) — sibling retry-guard scaffolding
2. `flutter_app/integration_test/{bash,edit}_tool_test.dart` (0.66) — card-named scaffolding
3. `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_preflight_probe_io.dart` ⇄ `flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart` (0.75) — probe + its guard
4. `ws_connector_io` ⇄ `ws_connector_web` (0.56) — platform-split twins
5. `folder_picker_web` ⇄ `upload_picker_web` (0.61) — picker family
6. `transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md` (0.55) — card twins, baseline-with-comment
7. `media_slot_picker_page_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.59) — drifted cross-package siblings
8. `provider_registry_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.62, containment 1.00) — fa_ui copy is a superset
9. `{transformers_js,webllm}_cache_section_test` (0.53) — provider twins
10. `agent_cli_tui_{adapter,socket}403_test` (0.52) — two flavours of one regression test
11. `fa_cli_thinking_{abort,livestream_pty}_test` — thinking-stream scaffolding
12. `provider_{ollama,openrouter}_test` — card-named scaffolding (anthropic leg drifted below threshold since the card's measurement)

Resolved vs the card's measurement: media_models_store + session_keys_store 1.00 pairs deleted; firebase + l10n pairs excluded. The tree drifted since the card's scan (upload_retry triple, cache_section, 403 and thinking pairs appeared) — all captured in the baseline with reasons.

## Disclosures

- **Duplication baseline re-recorded under 0.15.0**: the AC5 pin bump re-measures the `duplication` gate (216 → 245 entries; the detector's output changed with the version). The stale 0.14.2 baseline no longer matches under 0.15.0 — CI's `check --baseline` would be red on the version bump alone. Duplication stays severity `warning` (soft window per config), similarity is `error`.
- **CI is the arbiter** for the two flutter_app test deletions (flutter suite not runnable on this box) and for the exact 0.15.0-vs-0.15.x resolver behavior.

blocks.text:
# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  # TEMP raise (crap4dart 0.11.0 -> 0.14.2 migration, PR #1637, re-opens the
  # gh-1234 repin under the new analyzer): 0.14.2 counts pattern-matching /
  # switch complexity higher, re-measuring the provider-queue cluster above
  # the old 12.0 line. Measured on the CI pipeline (core coverage shards of
  # run 39324246012, merged via scripts/merge_lcov.py, analyze lib bin):
  # max CRAP 90.00 (`_typeName`, providers_queue.dart:629, CC 9 @ 0% cov),
  # then 35.00 (`BindingProvenance.label`, provider_model_binding.dart:69,
  # CC 8 @ 25%). Restore to 12.0 by decomposing the cluster under 0.14.2.
  # raise-issue: gh-1713
  threshold: 90.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
pre-commit

# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — loc scope (test/example)" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      ;;
    "")
      ;; # not activated — skip silently (CI and the fast gate cover it)
    *)
      echo "⚠️  crap4dart $C4D_VER is too old for the gates (need >= 0.11.0);" \
           "skipping — run: dart pub global activate crap4dart '>=0.11.0 <0.12.0'" >&2
      ;;
  esac
fi

# Golden-coverage quick check — only when the staged diff can affect the

  # The CI app-crap-gate job merges the two flutter-tests shard reports

    for name, (rel, marker) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue  # package not bootstrapped yet — nothing to assert
        checked += 1
        threshold = cfg[0]
        m = re.search(re.escape(marker) + r"([0-9.]+)", readme)
        if m is None:
            failures.append(

                f"{marker}<threshold>) while {rel} pins {threshold}"

            continue

            failures.append(
                f"{README}: {name} badge says CRAP {badge} but {rel} "
                f"pins {threshold} — sync them"

    """E1: both configs must carry the same generated-code exclude set."""
    failures = []
    found_any = False
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        found_any = True
        missing = GENERATED_EXCLUDES - cfg[1]
        if missing:
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: generated-code excludes drifted — missing {sorted(missing)} "
                f"(must match the other package's generated set)"
            )

        if current is None:

        if base is None:

            if RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER.search(text):

                f"— the CRAP ratchet is only-down; fix code, not config "
                f"(or link a restore issue via `# raise-issue: gh-<N>`)"
            )

    """Fixture-driven checks for every guard mode (AC1 RED/GREEN, E1, AC3)."""
    failures = []

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1774
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1774
- **Title**: feat(1738): similarity gate — 0 untracked near-duplicates in CI
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1738-similarity-gate` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +731
- **Deletions**: -817
- **Created**: 2026-10-21T21:21:13Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-22T01:57:32Z

## PR Description

Closes #1738.

## What

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).
- Bit-identical cross-package test copies **deleted**: `flutter_app/test/media_models_store_test.dart` and `flutter_app/test/session_keys_store_test.dart`. Both stores live in `packages/fa_ui` (`flutter_app/lib/services/*.dart` are one-line re-export shims); the flutter_app test copies differed from the fa_ui copies *only in the import lines* (fa_ui barrel vs shim paths). fa_ui keeps testing both stores beside the implementation — the card's preferred resolution ("whichever keeps both packages testing the store"). Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). They are codegen'd via `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` into separate Dart consts consumed with exact-string equality in 13 test assertions across 3 flutter-only test files; parameterizing means regenerating consts and rewriting exact-string tests in a package this lane cannot run — that's the prompt-corpus refactor card, not this one. Reason recorded in `crap4dart.yaml`.
- `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

## AC table

| AC | Status | Proof |
|----|--------|-------|
| AC1 — config + `check --only similarity` exits 0 | **MET** | `similarity: enabled: true`, md+dart, jaccard 0.5, containment 0.85 in `crap4dart.yaml`. `check --only similarity --baseline` → `exit 0` (`[PASS] similarity: 25 files in 12 similar-file clusters (3498 scanned)`). Note: plain `check --only similarity` (no `--baseline`) reports the 25 baselined findings and exits 2 — CI's quality-gates step runs `check --baseline`, which is the card's "only *new* near-duplicates fail" mode (AC1's exit-0 and AC4's mandatory baselining can only coexist in that mode). |
| AC2 — generated pairs glob-excluded with rationale | **MET** | `firebase_options.template.dart` + both `firebase_options.dart` copies + `app_localizations_*.dart` excluded via glob with comments (FlutterFire CLI output / gen-l10n ARB output). Also excluded with comments: `vendor/**` (every other gate excludes it; the card's 1637-file count implies vendor was out of its scope), `site/**` (generated deploy output of blog/), `.fah/**` (installed runtime mirrors of prompts/skills), `flutter_app/test/fixtures/retired_*.md` (frozen retired-revision fixture). |
| AC3 — bit-identical pair resolved; 0 clusters outside excludes+baseline | **MET** | Both 1.00 pairs (media_models_store, session_keys_store) deleted (see above). Post-change scan: 12 clusters / 25 files — all historical, all baselined. |
| AC4 — baseline captured; new duplicate fails | **MET** | `check --save-baseline` recorded 25 similarity findings (12 clusters). Negative proof, in the exact CI mode: copied `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` to a scratch doc → `check --only similarity --baseline` → `[FAIL] ... 27 files in 13 clusters` **exit 2** → scratch removed → gate green again. Baseline keys include the jaccard/containment values, so any drift in a clustered file re-fails the gate (deliberate re-baseline required). |
| AC5 — CI pins `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` | **MET** | Both `pub global activate crap4dart` lines in ci.yml bumped with gh-1738 comments. |

## Tooling disclosure

Ran locally in the worktree with the standalone Dart SDK recipe (`pub global activate crap4dart` → **0.15.0**, exact version as CI's new pin):

```
similarity scan (config)              3498 scanned, 281 skipped -> 25 files / 12 clusters
check --only similarity --baseline    exit 0
check --baseline (all gates)          exit 0  (loc PASS, broken_goldens PASS, duplication WARN-by-design)
check --only similarity               exit 2  (plain mode; reports the baselined inventory — disclosure line)
scratch-duplicate negative probe      exit 2  -> reverted -> green
```

## Fresh json re-inventory (card REG: exclude list changes require it)

3498 scanned (vendor/site/.fah excluded) → 12 clusters / 25 files, every cluster baselined with a reason in `crap4dart.yaml`:

1. `test/ci_{core_shard,pty_artifact,shard_evidence}_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (0.81/0.81/0.58) — sibling retry-guard scaffolding
2. `flutter_app/integration_test/{bash,edit}_tool_test.dart` (0.66) — card-named scaffolding
3. `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_preflight_probe_io.dart` ⇄ `flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart` (0.75) — probe + its guard
4. `ws_connector_io` ⇄ `ws_connector_web` (0.56) — platform-split twins
5. `folder_picker_web` ⇄ `upload_picker_web` (0.61) — picker family
6. `transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md` (0.55) — card twins, baseline-with-comment
7. `media_slot_picker_page_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.59) — drifted cross-package siblings
8. `provider_registry_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.62, containment 1.00) — fa_ui copy is a superset
9. `{transformers_js,webllm}_cache_section_test` (0.53) — provider twins
10. `agent_cli_tui_{adapter,socket}403_test` (0.52) — two flavours of one regression test
11. `fa_cli_thinking_{abort,livestream_pty}_test` — thinking-stream scaffolding
12. `provider_{ollama,openrouter}_test` — card-named scaffolding (anthropic leg drifted below threshold since the card's measurement)

Resolved vs the card's measurement: media_models_store + session_keys_store 1.00 pairs deleted; firebase + l10n pairs excluded. The tree drifted since the card's scan (upload_retry triple, cache_section, 403 and thinking pairs appeared) — all captured in the baseline with reasons.

## Disclosures

- **Duplication baseline re-recorded under 0.15.0**: the AC5 pin bump re-measures the `duplication` gate (216 → 245 entries; the detector's output changed with the version). The stale 0.14.2 baseline no longer matches under 0.15.0 — CI's `check --baseline` would be red on the version bump alone. Duplication stays severity `warning` (soft window per config), similarity is `error`.
- **CI is the arbiter** for the two flutter_app test deletions (flutter suite not runnable on this box) and for the exact 0.15.0-vs-0.15.x resolver behavior.

## What

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).

Both stores live in `packages/fa_ui` (`flutter_app/lib/services/*.dart` are one-line re-export shims); the flutter_app test copies differed from the fa_ui copies *only in the import lines* (fa_ui barrel vs shim paths). fa_ui keeps testing both stores beside the implementation — the card's preferred resolution ("whichever keeps both packages testing the store"). Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). # crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  # TEMP raise (crap4dart 0.11.0 -> 0.14.2 migration, PR #1637, re-opens the
  # gh-1234 repin under the new analyzer): 0.14.2 counts pattern-matching /
  # switch complexity higher, re-measuring the provider-queue cluster above
  # the old 12.0 line. Measured on the CI pipeline (core coverage shards of
  # run 39324246012, merged via scripts/merge_lcov.py, analyze lib bin):
  # max CRAP 90.00 (`_typeName`, providers_queue.dart:629, CC 9 @ 0% cov),
  # then 35.00 (`BindingProvenance.label`, provider_model_binding.dart:69,
  # CC 8 @ 25%). Restore to 12.0 by decomposing the cluster under 0.14.2.
  # raise-issue: gh-1713
  threshold: 90.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
