#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
pre-commit

# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  C4D_VER=$(dart pub global list 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="crap4dart"{print $2}')
  case "$C4D_VER" in
    # gh-1106: floor 0.11.0 — the root crap4dart.yaml duplication block
    # uses 0.11.0-only keys (ignore_locals/ignorable); the strict config
    # parser throws ConfigException on unknown keys, so older pins fail
    # rather than silently run without Type-2 detection.
    0.1[1-9].*|0.[2-9][0-9].*|[1-9].*)
      echo "🧪 crap4dart gates (staged core files)..."
      # gh-1106: --baseline — the Type-2 duplication gate ships with a
      # committed snapshot of pre-existing findings; hooks must flag only
      # NEW duplication, same contract as CI.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --baseline; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — crap4dart gates" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      # Issue #1234 rework: the ≤2800 ceiling over test/ + example/ via
      # the loc-scope companion config (the package config's sources are
      # [lib, bin]; 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override). No-ops
      # unless a staged file lives under test/ or example/.
      if ! dart pub global run crap4dart check --staged --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc; then
        echo "❌ QUALITY GATE FAILED — loc scope (test/example)" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      ;;
    "")
      ;; # not activated — skip silently (CI and the fast gate cover it)
    *)
      echo "⚠️  crap4dart $C4D_VER is too old for the gates (need >= 0.11.0);" \
           "skipping — run: dart pub global activate crap4dart '>=0.11.0 <0.12.0'" >&2
      ;;
  esac
fi

# Golden-coverage quick check — only when the staged diff can affect the
# flutter_app (the gate's own markers already told us the flutter stage
# ran or was skipped; recompute cheaply from the staged paths here).
STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only || true)
if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '^(flutter_app/|packages/|lib/|scripts/|\.github/|pubspec\.)' \

  if command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "🔍 Checking golden coverage..."
    if python3 scripts/check_goldens.py --quick; then
      echo "✅ Golden gate OK"
    else
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
fi

# Issue #433 AC1 (cheap, config-only): README CRAP badge must equal the

if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '(^|/)crap4dart\.yaml$|^README\.md$'; then

fi

  # raise-issue: gh-1713

coverage:
  # The CI app-crap-gate job merges the two flutter-tests shard reports
  # (scripts/merge_lcov.py) right before the CRAP step. Pre-commit stays
  # core-only: flutter coverage is too heavy for every commit.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  # flutter's lcov carries no BRDA branch records; branch coverage stays
  # a core-package gate concern.
  branch_coverage: false
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole flutter suite
  # first. Coverage comes from the CI shard merge (scripts/merge_lcov.py)
  # and pre-commit stays core-only (#433 split); nobody wants a second
  # suite run inside a 6-minute gate job.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This config is the single source of which gates `crap4dart check` runs
# (CI app-crap-gate job, pre-commit core hook): 0.9.5 default-enables ALL
# built-in gates, so everything not enforced below is disabled explicitly.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh
  # stage_size + the ci.yml shell guard). agent_service.dart and
  # wasm_shell.dart sit under 2800 today; the app_localizations*.dart
  # pattern covers ALL gen-l10n output (base + every locale variant —

  # edits, excluded here, not baselined.
  loc:
    enabled: true

  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}

  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}

  hardcoded_strings:
    enabled: true

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".yaml", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(proc.stdout)
        tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
    try:
        return parse_config(tmp_path)[0]
    finally:
        tmp_path.unlink()


def check_badges(root: Path):
    """AC1: every existing config's threshold must match its README badge."""
    readme = (root / README).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    failures = []
    checked = 0
    for name, (rel, marker) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue  # package not bootstrapped yet — nothing to assert
        checked += 1
        threshold = cfg[0]
        m = re.search(re.escape(marker) + r"([0-9.]+)", readme)
        if m is None:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: no badge for {name} (expected .../badge/"
                f"{marker}<threshold>) while {rel} pins {threshold}"
            )
            continue
        badge = float(m.group(1))
        if badge != threshold:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: {name} badge says CRAP {badge} but {rel} "
                f"pins {threshold} — sync them"
            )
    return checked, failures


def check_exclude_parity(root: Path):
    """E1: both configs must carry the same generated-code exclude set."""
    failures = []
    found_any = False
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        found_any = True
        missing = GENERATED_EXCLUDES - cfg[1]
        if missing:
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: generated-code excludes drifted — missing {sorted(missing)} "
                f"(must match the other package's generated set)"
            )
    return found_any, failures


def check_only_down(root: Path, base_ref: str):
    """AC3: no config's threshold may rise above its base-ref value."""
    failures = []
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        current = parse_config(root / rel)
        if current is None:
            continue
        base = read_threshold_at(base_ref, rel)
        if base is None:
            continue  # new config (bootstrap) — nothing recorded yet
        if current[0] > base + 1e-9:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER.search(text):
                continue  # sanctioned temporary raise — restore issue linked
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: threshold rose {base} -> {current[0]} since {base_ref} "
                f"— the CRAP ratchet is only-down; fix code, not config "
                f"(or link a restore issue via `# raise-issue: gh-<N>`)"
            )
    return failures


def self_test():
    """Fixture-driven checks for every guard mode (AC1 RED/GREEN, E1, AC3)."""
    failures = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)

        def write(readme_badge, yaml_threshold, excludes=GENERATED_EXCLUDES):
            (root / README).write_text(
                f"[![x](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAP%20max-{readme_badge}"
                f"-brightgreen)](https://example.com)\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
                "sources: [lib]\n"
                "exclude:\n"
                + "".join(f"  - '{p}'\n" for p in sorted(excludes))
                + f"crap:\n  threshold: {yaml_threshold}\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        # AC1 RED: badge drifted from threshold.
        write("8.0", 12.0)
        _, fails = check_badges(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: badge drift was NOT detected")

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1774
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1774
- **Title**: feat(1738): similarity gate — 0 untracked near-duplicates in CI
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1738-similarity-gate` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +731
- **Deletions**: -817
- **Created**: 2026-10-21T21:21:13Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-22T01:57:32Z

## PR Description

Closes #1738.

## What

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).
- Bit-identical cross-package test copies **deleted**: `flutter_app/test/media_models_store_test.dart` and `flutter_app/test/session_keys_store_test.dart`. Both stores live in `packages/fa_ui` (`flutter_app/lib/services/*.dart` are one-line re-export shims); the flutter_app test copies differed from the fa_ui copies *only in the import lines* (fa_ui barrel vs shim paths). fa_ui keeps testing both stores beside the implementation — the card's preferred resolution ("whichever keeps both packages testing the store"). Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). They are codegen'd via `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` into separate Dart consts consumed with exact-string equality in 13 test assertions across 3 flutter-only test files; parameterizing means regenerating consts and rewriting exact-string tests in a package this lane cannot run — that's the prompt-corpus refactor card, not this one. Reason recorded in `crap4dart.yaml`.
- `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

## AC table

| AC | Status | Proof |
|----|--------|-------|
| AC1 — config + `check --only similarity` exits 0 | **MET** | `similarity: enabled: true`, md+dart, jaccard 0.5, containment 0.85 in `crap4dart.yaml`. `check --only similarity --baseline` → `exit 0` (`[PASS] similarity: 25 files in 12 similar-file clusters (3498 scanned)`). Note: plain `check --only similarity` (no `--baseline`) reports the 25 baselined findings and exits 2 — CI's quality-gates step runs `check --baseline`, which is the card's "only *new* near-duplicates fail" mode (AC1's exit-0 and AC4's mandatory baselining can only coexist in that mode). |
| AC2 — generated pairs glob-excluded with rationale | **MET** | `firebase_options.template.dart` + both `firebase_options.dart` copies + `app_localizations_*.dart` excluded via glob with comments (FlutterFire CLI output / gen-l10n ARB output). Also excluded with comments: `vendor/**` (every other gate excludes it; the card's 1637-file count implies vendor was out of its scope), `site/**` (generated deploy output of blog/), `.fah/**` (installed runtime mirrors of prompts/skills), `flutter_app/test/fixtures/retired_*.md` (frozen retired-revision fixture). |
| AC3 — bit-identical pair resolved; 0 clusters outside excludes+baseline | **MET** | Both 1.00 pairs (media_models_store, session_keys_store) deleted (see above). Post-change scan: 12 clusters / 25 files — all historical, all baselined. |
| AC4 — baseline captured; new duplicate fails | **MET** | `check --save-baseline` recorded 25 similarity findings (12 clusters). Negative proof, in the exact CI mode: copied `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` to a scratch doc → `check --only similarity --baseline` → `[FAIL] ... 27 files in 13 clusters` **exit 2** → scratch removed → gate green again. Baseline keys include the jaccard/containment values, so any drift in a clustered file re-fails the gate (deliberate re-baseline required). |
| AC5 — CI pins `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` | **MET** | Both `pub global activate crap4dart` lines in ci.yml bumped with gh-1738 comments. |

## Tooling disclosure

Ran locally in the worktree with the standalone Dart SDK recipe (`pub global activate crap4dart` → **0.15.0**, exact version as CI's new pin):

```
similarity scan (config)              3498 scanned, 281 skipped -> 25 files / 12 clusters
check --only similarity --baseline    exit 0
check --baseline (all gates)          exit 0  (loc PASS, broken_goldens PASS, duplication WARN-by-design)
check --only similarity               exit 2  (plain mode; reports the baselined inventory — disclosure line)
scratch-duplicate negative probe      exit 2  -> reverted -> green
```

## Fresh json re-inventory (card REG: exclude list changes require it)

3498 scanned (vendor/site/.fah excluded) → 12 clusters / 25 files, every cluster baselined with a reason in `crap4dart.yaml`:

1. `test/ci_{core_shard,pty_artifact,shard_evidence}_upload_retry_guard_test.dart` (0.81/0.81/0.58) — sibling retry-guard scaffolding
2. `flutter_app/integration_test/{bash,edit}_tool_test.dart` (0.66) — card-named scaffolding
3. `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_preflight_probe_io.dart` ⇄ `flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart` (0.75) — probe + its guard
4. `ws_connector_io` ⇄ `ws_connector_web` (0.56) — platform-split twins
5. `folder_picker_web` ⇄ `upload_picker_web` (0.61) — picker family
6. `transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md` (0.55) — card twins, baseline-with-comment
7. `media_slot_picker_page_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.59) — drifted cross-package siblings
8. `provider_registry_test` flutter_app ⇄ fa_ui (0.62, containment 1.00) — fa_ui copy is a superset
9. `{transformers_js,webllm}_cache_section_test` (0.53) — provider twins
10. `agent_cli_tui_{adapter,socket}403_test` (0.52) — two flavours of one regression test
11. `fa_cli_thinking_{abort,livestream_pty}_test` — thinking-stream scaffolding
12. `provider_{ollama,openrouter}_test` — card-named scaffolding (anthropic leg drifted below threshold since the card's measurement)

Resolved vs the card's measurement: media_models_store + session_keys_store 1.00 pairs deleted; firebase + l10n pairs excluded. The tree drifted since the card's scan (upload_retry triple, cache_section, 403 and thinking pairs appeared) — all captured in the baseline with reasons.

## Disclosures

- **Duplication baseline re-recorded under 0.15.0**: the AC5 pin bump re-measures the `duplication` gate (216 → 245 entries; the detector's output changed with the version). The stale 0.14.2 baseline no longer matches under 0.15.0 — CI's `check --baseline` would be red on the version bump alone. Duplication stays severity `warning` (soft window per config), similarity is `error`.
- **CI is the arbiter** for the two flutter_app test deletions (flutter suite not runnable on this box) and for the exact 0.15.0-vs-0.15.x resolver behavior.

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.

They are codegen'd via `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` into separate Dart consts consumed with exact-string equality in 13 test assertions across 3 flutter-only test files; parameterizing means regenerating consts and rewriting exact-string tests in a package this lane cannot run — that's the prompt-corpus refactor card, not this one. Reason recorded in `crap4dart.yaml`.
- `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

| AC | Status | Proof |
|----|--------|-------|
| AC1 — config + `check --only similarity` exits 0 | **MET** | `similarity: enabled: true`, md+dart, jaccard 0.5, containment 0.85 in `crap4dart.yaml`. `check --only similarity --baseline` → `exit 0` (`[PASS] similarity: 25 files in 12 similar-file clusters (3498 scanned)`). | AC4 — baseline captured; new duplicate fails | **MET** | `check --save-baseline` recorded 25 similarity findings (12 clusters). Negative proof, in the exact CI mode: copied `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` to a scratch doc → `check --only similarity --baseline` → `[FAIL] ... 27 files in 13 clusters` **exit 2** → scratch removed → gate green again. Baseline keys include the jaccard/containment values, so any drift in a clustered file re-fails the gate (deliberate re-baseline required). |

## What

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).

CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.

coverage:

  # before the CRAP step runs.

  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.

    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'

  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known

    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #

    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins

    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a

  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:

      - 'test/integration/**'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then

def check_badges(root: Path):
    """AC1: every existing config's threshold must match its README badge."""
    readme = (root / README).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    failures = []
    checked = 0
    for name, (rel, marker) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue  # package not bootstrapped yet — nothing to assert
        checked += 1
        threshold = cfg[0]
        m = re.search(re.escape(marker) + r"([0-9.]+)", readme)
        if m is None:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: no badge for {name} (expected .../badge/"
                f"{marker}<threshold>) while {rel} pins {threshold}"
            )
            continue
        badge = float(m.group(1))
        if badge != threshold:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: {name} badge says CRAP {badge} but {rel} "
                f"pins {threshold} — sync them"
            )
    return checked, failures


def check_exclude_parity(root: Path):
    """E1: both configs must carry the same generated-code exclude set."""
    failures = []
    found_any = False
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        found_any = True
        missing = GENERATED_EXCLUDES - cfg[1]
        if missing:
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: generated-code excludes drifted — missing {sorted(missing)} "
                f"(must match the other package's generated set)"
            )
    return found_any, failures


def check_only_down(root: Path, base_ref: str):
    """AC3: no config's threshold may rise above its base-ref value."""
    failures = []
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        current = parse_config(root / rel)
        if current is None:
            continue
        base = read_threshold_at(base_ref, rel)
        if base is None:
            continue  # new config (bootstrap) — nothing recorded yet
        if current[0] > base + 1e-9:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER.search(text):
                continue  # sanctioned temporary raise — restore issue linked
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: threshold rose {base} -> {current[0]} since {base_ref} "
                f"— the CRAP ratchet is only-down; fix code, not config "
                f"(or link a restore issue via `# raise-issue: gh-<N>`)"
            )
    return failures


def self_test():
    """Fixture-driven checks for every guard mode (AC1 RED/GREEN, E1, AC3)."""
    failures = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)

        def write(readme_badge, yaml_threshold, excludes=GENERATED_EXCLUDES):
            (root / README).write_text(
                f"[![x](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAP%20max-{readme_badge}"
                f"-brightgreen)](https://example.com)\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
                "sources: [lib]\n"
                "exclude:\n"
                + "".join(f"  - '{p}'\n" for p in sorted(excludes))
                + f"crap:\n  threshold: {yaml_threshold}\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        # AC1 RED: badge drifted from threshold.
        write("8.0", 12.0)
        _, fails = check_badges(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: badge drift was NOT detected")

# pr-1774: feat(1738): similarity gate — 0 untracked near-duplicates in CI

## Description

Closes #1738.

## What

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

- `crap4dart.yaml`: `gates.similarity` enabled — md+dart, `jaccard 0.5`, `containment 0.85`, `min_shingles 50` (default = the card's measured skip line). Glob-excludes with rationale comments; baseline rationale documented per-cluster in the same file (the baseline json can't carry comments).
- Bit-identical cross-package test copies **deleted**: `flutter_app/test/media_models_store_test.dart` and `flutter_app/test/session_keys_store_test.dart`. Both stores live in `packages/fa_ui` (`flutter_app/lib/services/*.dart` are one-line re-export shims); the flutter_app test copies differed from the fa_ui copies *only in the import lines* (fa_ui barrel vs shim paths). fa_ui keeps testing both stores beside the implementation — the card's preferred resolution ("whichever keeps both packages testing the store"). Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). They are codegen'd via `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` into separate Dart consts consumed with exact-string equality in 13 test assertions across 3 flutter-only test files; parameterizing means regenerating consts and rewriting exact-string tests in a package this lane cannot run — that's the prompt-corpus refactor card, not this one. Reason recorded in `crap4dart.yaml`.
- `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

## AC table

| AC | Status | Proof |
|----|--------|-------|
| AC1 — config + `check --only similarity` exits 0 | **MET** | `similarity: enabled: true`, md+dart, jaccard 0.5, containment 0.85 in `crap4dart.yaml`. `check --only similarity --baseline` → `exit 0` (`[PASS] similarity: 25 files in 12 similar-file clusters (3498 scanned)`). Note: plain `check --only similarity` (no `--baseline`) reports the 25 baselined findings and exits 2 — CI's quality-gates step runs `check --baseline`, which is the card's "only *new* near-duplicates fail" mode (AC1's exit-0 and AC4's mandatory baselining can only coexist in that mode). |
| AC2 — generated pairs glob-excluded with rationale | **MET** | `firebase_options.template.dart` + both `firebase_options.dart` copies + `app_localizations_*.dart` excluded via glob with comments (FlutterFire CLI output / gen-l10n ARB output). Also excluded with comments: `vendor/**` (every other gate excludes it; the card's 1637-file count implies vendor was out of its scope), `site/**` (generated deploy output of blog/), `.fah/**` (installed runtime mirrors of prompts/skills), `flutter_app/test/fixtures/retired_*.md` (frozen retired-revision fixture). |
| AC3 — bit-identical pair resolved; 0 clusters outside excludes+baseline | **MET** | Both 1.00 pairs (media_models_store, session_keys_store) deleted (see above). Post-change scan: 12 clusters / 25 files — all historical, all baselined. |
| AC4 — baseline captured; new duplicate fails | **MET** | `check --save-baseline` recorded 25 similarity findings (12 clusters). Negative proof, in the exact CI mode: copied `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` to a scratch doc → `check --only similarity --baseline` → `[FAIL] ... 27 files in 13 clusters` **exit 2** → scratch removed → gate green again. Baseline keys include the jaccard/containment values, so any drift in a clustered file re-fails the gate (deliberate re-baseline required). |
| AC5 — CI pins `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` | **MET** | Both `pub global activate crap4dart` lines in ci.yml bumped with gh-1738 comments. |

## Tooling disclosure

Ran locally in the worktree with the standalone Dart SDK recipe (`pub global activate crap4dart` → **0.15.0**, exact version as CI's new pin):

```
similarity scan (config)              3498 scanned, 281 skipped -> 25 files / 12 clusters
check --only similarity --baseline    exit 0
check --baseline (all gates)          exit 0  (loc PASS, broken_goldens PASS, duplication WARN-by-design)
check --only similarity               exit 2  (plain mode; reports the baselined inventory — disclosure line)
scratch-duplicate negative probe      exit 2  -> reverted -> green
```

## Fresh json re-inventory (card REG: exclude list changes require it)

3498 scanned (vendor/site/.fah excluded) → 12 clusters / 25 files, every cluster baselined with a reason in `crap4dart.yaml`:

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  # TEMP raise (crap4dart 0.11.0 -> 0.14.2 migration, PR #1637, re-opens the
  # gh-1234 repin under the new analyzer): 0.14.2 counts pattern-matching /
  # switch complexity higher, re-measuring the provider-queue cluster above
  # the old 12.0 line. Measured on the CI pipeline (core coverage shards of
  # run 39324246012, merged via scripts/merge_lcov.py, analyze lib bin):
  # max CRAP 90.00 (`_typeName`, providers_queue.dart:629, CC 9 @ 0% cov),
  # then 35.00 (`BindingProvenance.label`, provider_model_binding.dart:69,
  # CC 8 @ 25%). Restore to 12.0 by decomposing the cluster under 0.14.2.
  # raise-issue: gh-1713
  threshold: 90.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). ERROR since crap4dart >=0.14.2 fixed the upstream
  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: terminal text is blocky mono
      # glyphs that read as solid Ahem rectangles (5 theme screenshots,
      # crap4dart 0.14.2), and omp_ref/03_tool_call.png genuinely
      # contains a yellow/black pattern. Not golden images — excluded,
      # not a detector bug to chase.
      - 'test/integration/**'

  # File-level near-duplicate gate (issue #1738, crap4dart 0.15.0).
…

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
pre-commit

  hardcoded_strings:

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".yaml", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(proc.stdout)
        tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
    try:
        return parse_config(tmp_path)[0]
    finally:
        tmp_path.unlink()


def check_badges(root: Path):
    """AC1: every existing config's threshold must match its README badge."""
    readme = (root / README).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    failures = []
    checked = 0
    for name, (rel, marker) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue  # package not bootstrapped yet — nothing to assert
        checked += 1
        threshold = cfg[0]
        m = re.search(re.escape(marker) + r"([0-9.]+)", readme)
        if m is None:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: no badge for {name} (expected .../badge/"
                f"{marker}<threshold>) while {rel} pins {threshold}"
            )
            continue
        badge = float(m.group(1))
        if badge != threshold:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: {name} badge says CRAP {badge} but {rel} "
                f"pins {threshold} — sync them"
            )
    return checked, failures


def check_exclude_parity(root: Path):
    """E1: both configs must carry the same generated-code exclude set."""
    failures = []
    found_any = False
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        found_any = True
        missing = GENERATED_EXCLUDES - cfg[1]
        if missing:
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: generated-code excludes drifted — missing {sorted(missing)} "
                f"(must match the other package's generated set)"
            )
    return found_any, failures


def check_only_down(root: Path, base_ref: str):
    """AC3: no config's threshold may rise above its base-ref value."""
    failures = []
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        current = parse_config(root / rel)
        if current is None:
            continue
        base = read_threshold_at(base_ref, rel)
        if base is None:
            continue  # new config (bootstrap) — nothing recorded yet
        if current[0] > base + 1e-9:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER.search(text):
                continue  # sanctioned temporary raise — restore issue linked
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: threshold rose {base} -> {current[0]} since {base_ref} "
                f"— the CRAP ratchet is only-down; fix code, not config "
                f"(or link a restore issue via `# raise-issue: gh-<N>`)"
            )
    return failures


def self_test():
    """Fixture-driven checks for every guard mode (AC1 RED/GREEN, E1, AC3)."""
    failures = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)

        def write(readme_badge, yaml_threshold, excludes=GENERATED_EXCLUDES):
            (root / README).write_text(
                f"[![x](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAP%20max-{readme_badge}"
                f"-brightgreen)](https://example.com)\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
                "sources: [lib]\n"
                "exclude:\n"
                + "".join(f"  - '{p}'\n" for p in sorted(excludes))
                + f"crap:\n  threshold: {yaml_threshold}\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        # AC1 RED: badge drifted from threshold.
        write("8.0", 12.0)
        _, fails = check_badges(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: badge drift was NOT detected")

env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin + extsize arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1659: the office add-in acceptance suite — the exact path
          # list the retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers
          # carried. Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke
          # (pull_request + validation dispatch); the classifier failure
          # arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^office_addin/|^flutter_app/|^packages/|^lib/|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/build_office_addin\.sh$|^\.github/workflows/office-addin\.yml$)'; then
            echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1684 AC3: the extension size gate — extension sources and
          # vendor supply-chain lock, the build/packaging scripts, the
          # size baseline itself (a reseed PR must re-prove the floor)
          # and everything that compiles INTO the zip (the panel app is
          # the flutter_app web build; sw/agent.js compiles lib/ + the
          # root package set). The root vendor/ tree is armed too: the
          # patched forks (xterm, dart_tui, wasm_run*) are path deps —
          # no content hash in pubspec.lock — so a fork edit moves the
          # zip manifest with no other covered path touched. The gate
          # tool itself and root pubspec_overrides.yaml (dart pub get
          # for the dart2js agent build) are armed for the same reason:
          # a change to enforcement or to the dependency set must
          # re-prove the floor. Gated on the SAME two events as
          # exzone/locksmoke (pull_request + validation dispatch); the
          # classifier failure arm above runs it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^browser_ext/|^flutter_app/|^lib/|^packages/|^vendor/|^pubspec\.yaml$|^pubspec_overrides\.yaml$|^pubspec\.lock$|^scripts/(build_browser_ext|fetch_vendor_assets|stage_extension_panel|ext_package_guard|prune_flutter_assets)\.|^scripts/size_manifest\.py$|^scripts/size_budget/fa-extension\.tsv$|^\.github/workflows/(ci|build-macos|pages)\.yml$)'; then
            echo "extsize=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
            # Dispatch done — the stages classifier below reads a
            # pull_request event's base/head only; on dispatches the group
            # outputs stay with the non-PR filter step (full gate).
            exit 0
          fi
          stages=$(scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run |
            sed -n 's/^Fast gate scope: .*stages://p')
          echo "gate stages:[$stages]"
          # Empty output can only mean detection failure: full gate.

    "description": "Closes #1738.

Enables crap4dart's file-level `similarity` gate on this repo's md+dart corpus and drives the measured inventory to the card's target state: **known clusters fixed or baselined, by-design twins glob-excluded, new copies fail CI.**

Neither file is referenced by any shard manifest (`faui_test_shards.json` paths are fa_ui-relative and list the kept copies; the weekly rebalance absorbs the deletions). CI flutter shards are the arbiter — flutter tests are not runnable on this lane's box.
- Twin prompt notes (`transformers_js_no_tools_note.md` ⇄ `webllm_no_tools_note.md`, 0.55): **baselined with comment** (the card's sanctioned alternative to merging). - `ci.yml`: both CRAP jobs pinned `>=0.15.0 <0.16.0` (AC5; similarity shipped in 0.15.0).

| AC | Status | Proof |

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  # TEMP raise (crap4dart 0.11.0 -> 0.14.2 migration, PR #1637, re-opens the
  # gh-1234 repin under the new analyzer): 0.14.2 counts pattern-matching /
  # switch complexity higher, re-measuring the provider-queue cluster above
  # the old 12.0 line. Measured on the CI pipeline (core coverage shards of
  # run 39324246012, merged via scripts/merge_lcov.py, analyze lib bin):
  # max CRAP 90.00 (`_typeName`, providers_queue.dart:629, CC 9 @ 0% cov),
  # then 35.00 (`BindingProvenance.label`, provider_model_binding.dart:69,
  # CC 8 @ 25%). Restore to 12.0 by decomposing the cluster under 0.14.2.
  # raise-issue: gh-1713
  threshold: 90.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). ERROR since crap4dart >=0.14.2 fixed the upstream
  # detector bugs (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow-box
  # ambiguity) — scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed is the
  # flip gate and it is MET.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: error
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: terminal text is blocky mono
      # glyphs that read as solid Ahem rectangles (5 theme screenshots,
      # crap4dart 0.14.2), and omp_ref/03_tool_call.png genuinely
      # contains a yellow/black pattern. Not golden images — excluded,
      # not a detector bug to chase.
      - 'test/integration/**'

  # File-level near-duplicate gate (issue #1738, crap4dart 0.15.0).

1. **Schema validity of the new yaml keys** — confirmed implicitly: crap4dart 0.15.0 parsed the config fine (no ConfigException) and the gate ran with jaccard/containment settings (the output shows clusters at jaccard >= 0.5).

2. **`min_shingles: 50`** — the PR text says min_shingles 50 is the default. The yaml doesn't set it explicitly (comment says "default = the card's measured skip line"). OK.

3. **CI drift risk**: the core job's "CRAP ratchet" step runs `analyze` (which doesn't gate) and "Quality gates" runs `check --baseline`. But WAIT — there's an important subtlety: the quality-gates step has condition `needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'`. The similarity gate now scans the ENTIRE repo md+dart corpus (3514 files) from ANY core/shared change. A PR touching only, say, a markdown doc in blog/ — does `core` or `shared` changes filter include md files? If a PR edits only `blog/**` md files and doesn't trip the `core`/`shared` filter, the gate won't run... not a correctness issue for this PR (gate simply doesn't run). Fine.

But more important: **the flutter_app job's final step** `cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check` — runs the flutter_app config `check` WITHOUT `--baseline`. The flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml doesn't mention similarity. In crap4dart 0.15.0, is similarity enabled BY DEFAULT (like 0.9.5 default-enabled all gates)? The root config comment says "0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly". #!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  QUALITY GATE — DO NOT LOWER THESE THRESHOLDS WITHOUT TEAM APPROVAL       ║
# ║  Every commit must pass: file size (crap4dart loc), analyze, tests,       ║
# ║  coverage ≥ 80%, CRAP ratchet (crap4dart.yaml), duplication < 1%.         ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Pre-commit hook for flutter_agent_harness (pure Dart package).
# Canonical copy: scripts/pre-commit — install with:
#   cp scripts/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
# To skip (emergency only): git commit --no-verify
#
# Issue #177 (AC7): the hook is a THIN WRAPPER over scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh —
# the exact script CI runs — with the same path filters: a docs-only commit
# no longer pays for the flutter suite, a lib-only commit skips flutter_app
# stages. Hook-specific extras that stay here (they make no sense in CI):
#   1. dart format SELF-HEAL of staged files (reformat + re-stage, blocking
#      backstop when the formatter can't),
#   2. the golden-coverage quick check (check_goldens.py --quick) — local
#      golden hygiene; pixel goldens themselves run inside the gate's
#      flutter stage.
# Parity check: both callers print `GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP <reason>`
# markers; diffing the hook's markers against CI's must be empty.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# THE shared fast gate (same script, same path filters as CI). --hook makes
# it derive the scope from the STAGED diff. It unsets GIT_* env itself
# after reading hook mode.
bash scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --hook

# Issue #447: crap4dart quality gates over the STAGED core diff
# (core-only #433 split — the flutter_app gates run in CI's
# app-crap-gate job). The root crap4dart.yaml enables exactly
# broken_goldens; `check --staged` no-ops when no Dart file is staged.
# Equivalent to the managed block `crap4dart install --force` would
# append — do not stack both. Requires crap4dart >= 0.9 (the gate
# framework; older pins only knew `analyze`).
pre-commit

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".yaml", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(proc.stdout)
        tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
    try:
        return parse_config(tmp_path)[0]
    finally:
        tmp_path.unlink()


def check_badges(root: Path):
    """AC1: every existing config's threshold must match its README badge."""
    readme = (root / README).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    failures = []
    checked = 0
    for name, (rel, marker) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue  # package not bootstrapped yet — nothing to assert
        checked += 1
        threshold = cfg[0]
        m = re.search(re.escape(marker) + r"([0-9.]+)", readme)
        if m is None:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: no badge for {name} (expected .../badge/"
                f"{marker}<threshold>) while {rel} pins {threshold}"
            )
            continue
        badge = float(m.group(1))
        if badge != threshold:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: {name} badge says CRAP {badge} but {rel} "
                f"pins {threshold} — sync them"
            )
    return checked, failures


def check_exclude_parity(root: Path):
    """E1: both configs must carry the same generated-code exclude set."""
    failures = []
    found_any = False
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        found_any = True
        missing = GENERATED_EXCLUDES - cfg[1]
        if missing:
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: generated-code excludes drifted — missing {sorted(missing)} "
                f"(must match the other package's generated set)"
            )
    return found_any, failures


def check_only_down(root: Path, base_ref: str):
    """AC3: no config's threshold may rise above its base-ref value."""
    failures = []
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        current = parse_config(root / rel)
        if current is None:
            continue
        base = read_threshold_at(base_ref, rel)
        if base is None:
            continue  # new config (bootstrap) — nothing recorded yet
        if current[0] > base + 1e-9:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER.search(text):
                continue  # sanctioned temporary raise — restore issue linked
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: threshold rose {base} -> {current[0]} since {base_ref} "
                f"— the CRAP ratchet is only-down; fix code, not config "
                f"(or link a restore issue via `# raise-issue: gh-<N>`)"
            )
    return failures


def self_test():
    """Fixture-driven checks for every guard mode (AC1 RED/GREEN, E1, AC3)."""
    failures = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)

        def write(readme_badge, yaml_threshold, excludes=GENERATED_EXCLUDES):
            (root / README).write_text(
                f"[![x](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAP%20max-{readme_badge}"
                f"-brightgreen)](https://example.com)\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
                "sources: [lib]\n"
                "exclude:\n"
                + "".join(f"  - '{p}'\n" for p in sorted(excludes))
                + f"crap:\n  threshold: {yaml_threshold}\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        # AC1 RED: badge drifted from threshold.
        write("8.0", 12.0)
        _, fails = check_badges(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: badge drift was NOT detected")

#   --scope all   Run every stage.
#   --scope core  analyze + test-core + coverage + crap + dup + dupx.
#   --scope app   analyze + dup + dupx + flutter.
#   --scope docs  analyze only.
#   --stages l    Comma-separated stage list; overrides the scope-derived set.
#                 Known stages: analyze,test-core,coverage,crap,dup,dupx,flutter,integration-mock
#
#
# Path rules (union logic, E1; test/** counts as core, E6):
#   docs/ | *.md | prompts/ .................. analyze
#   lib/ | bin/ | test/ | pubspec.* .......... + test-core, coverage, crap, dup, dupx
#   test/integration/** ...................... + integration-mock (no-key legs,
#                                              MockLlmServer; issue #551)
#   flutter_app/ | packages/ ................. + dup, dupx, flutter
#   scripts/ | .github/ | crap4dart.yaml ..... ALL stages (safe default, E2)
#   anything unknown ......................... ALL stages (safe default)
#
# Concurrency overrides: FA_DART_TEST_CONCURRENCY / FA_FLUTTER_TEST_CONCURRENCY
# (auto-throttled via detect_test_concurrency, same as scripts/pre-commit).
# Flake budget (gh-1026): FA_GATE_PTY_RETRIES=N makes the integration-mock
# stage rerun ONLY its failed files, up to N times, before failing — the
# load-sensitive PTY/grid timing legs stop costing a full 2.5 h leg per
# ambient flake (default 0 = single-shot, behaviour unchanged).
#
# CRAP ratchet scoping: in --hook mode the analyze runs over the STAGED
# lib/bin files only — the ratchet guards what a commit touches, so a
# pre-existing offender in an untouched file cannot block an unrelated
# commit. Non-hook runs (and ci.yml's whole-repo `crap4dart analyze`)
# keep the full-repo view, so nothing escapes the ratchet permanently.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# Unset git env vars so test processes that spawn git subprocesses use the
# correct working directory rather than the hook's environment. The --hook
# scope detection below reads GIT_INDEX_FILE BEFORE this line runs.
SCOPE=auto
STAGES_OVERRIDE=""
HOOK_MODE=0
DRY_RUN=0
if [ "${GIT_INDEX_FILE:-}" ]; then HOOK_MODE=1; fi
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --scope) SCOPE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --scope=*) SCOPE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --stages) STAGES_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --stages=*) STAGES_OVERRIDE="${1#*=}"; shift ;;
    --hook) HOOK_MODE=1; shift ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;   # print derived scope/stages, run nothing
    *) echo "Unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
unset GIT_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_WORK_TREE 2>/dev/null || true

COVERAGE_BASELINE=80.0
DUP_THRESHOLD=1.0
# flutter_app duplication ratchet: only allowed DOWN from the pinned ~3.66%.
DUP_THRESHOLD_APP=3.7
# Cross-module duplication ratchet (issue #487): clones spanning module
# roots (lib, bin, flutter_app/lib, packages/*/lib, browser_ext/dart) as a
# % of the combined surface. Baseline 0.3013% measured at #487; only
# allowed DOWN from the pinned 0.31 (scripts/check_dup_cross_module.sh).
DUP_THRESHOLD_XMOD=0.31

ALL_STAGES="analyze test-core coverage crap dup dupx flutter integration-mock"

# ── Load-aware test concurrency (copied from scripts/pre-commit) ───────────
# A busy box (other agents, IDE builds) makes widget tests' runAsync() flake
# and real-timer hub tests miss windows at full parallelism.
detect_test_concurrency() {
  local cores load1
  if command -v sysctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    cores=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print int($2)}')
  elif [ -r /proc/loadavg ]; then
    cores=$(nproc 2>/dev/null)
    load1=$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/loadavg)
  fi
  if [ -n "$cores" ] && [ -n "$load1" ] && [ "$load1" -ge $((cores / 2)) ]; then
    echo 2
  fi
  # Empty output on an idle box = no --concurrency flag (package defaults).
}

# ── Stage selection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SELECTED is a space-separated stage set; APP_IN_SCOPE tracks whether
# flutter_app/packages changed (analyze stage runs flutter analyze then).
SELECTED=""
APP_IN_SCOPE=0

add_stages() {
  local s
  for s in $1; do
    case " $SELECTED " in
      *" $s "*) ;;               # union: already present
      *) SELECTED="$SELECTED $s" ;;
    esac
  done
}

classify_path() {
  # Echoes the stage group contributed by one changed path (union logic).
  case "$1" in
    scripts/*|.github/*|crap4dart.yaml|crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) echo "all" ;;
    test/integration/*) echo "integ" ;;
    lib/*|bin/*|test/*|example/*|pubspec.yaml|pubspec.*) echo "core" ;;
    flutter_app/*|packages/*) echo "app" ;;
    docs/*|prompts/*|*.md) echo "docs" ;;
    *) echo "all" ;;             # unknown path: safe default (E2)
  esac
}

resolve_scope() {
  case "$SCOPE" in
    all) add_stages "$ALL_STAGES"; APP_IN_SCOPE=1 ;;
